notes: Ervo Shopping (Android): ask Ervo to buy your list and it opens the store's website in its own window over the chat, searches, picks, adds to the cart, swaps items and sets amounts while you watch. Pause, take over or give it back anytime

When something is missing, Ervo asks: how you want the order, your car for curbside, an address for delivery. Signing in and paying stay yours, in that same window; Ervo never sees your password or card
Updates always land on the newest version and show the notes of any you skipped
highlights: Ervo shops the store's site while you watch
It asks for what's missing, you sign in and pay
Updates jump to the newest version
Clear any span of your calendar in one go
Gray glass look and the new owls
Long, multi-part messages are answered in full
Ideas stay with the right Ervo
Ideas stay with the right Ervo
Each Ervo fetches its own page
